episodeTitle.en: Why Netflix is betting on systems thinkers—not specialists—in the AI era | Elizabeth Stone (CPTO)
episodeTitle.zh: AI 时代，Netflix 为什么看重系统思考者，胜过专才？｜首席产品与技术官 Elizabeth Stone

guestBioOfficial.zh: Elizabeth Stone 在本期录制时是 Netflix 首席产品与技术官，负责工程、产品与设计。上次受访时她还是 CTO。横跨数据科学、技术和产品的经历，让她尤其关注一项局部优化会怎样影响整个观看体验。
guestBioOfficial.en: Elizabeth Stone oversees engineering, product, and design at Netflix. Previously its CTO, she brings experience across data science and product to questions about how a local change affects the viewing experience.

title.en: Why Netflix is betting on systems thinkers—not specialists—in the AI era | Elizabeth Stone (CPTO)
title.zh: AI 时代，Netflix 为什么看重系统思考者，胜过专才？｜首席产品与技术官 Elizabeth Stone

summary.zh: 当设计师也能写代码、工程师也能做原型，Netflix 招人时究竟看什么？Elizabeth 从岗位边界谈到推荐、创作与基础设施，最后落到她自己的疑问：如果模型写出的代码更快，却没人说得清为什么，团队能否放心接手？
summary.en: Elizabeth follows the shift in roles at Netflix from hiring to creative work and infrastructure. A faster piece of model-written code becomes a concrete test of whether a team can understand and maintain what it ships.

insights.title: 岗位变宽，招聘问题也要变
insights.detail: Elizabeth 希望候选人能把一个功能放回整个系统考察，也愿意在答案尚不明确时亲手试验。这样的好奇心会改变团队需要的技能组合。
insights.detailEn: Netflix looks for curiosity about the wider system and a willingness to experiment while roles are changing.

insights.title: 同一家公司的 AI 问题也各不相同
insights.detail: 创作、消费产品和基础设施都用得上 AI。Elizabeth 提醒，许多已经在用的场景甚至不涉及生成内容。
insights.detailEn: Creative production, consumer products, and infrastructure pose different AI problems. Many existing uses are not generative.

insights.title: 性能提升之后，谁能修它？
insights.detail: 模型产出的代码可能跑得更快。Elizabeth 仍想知道快在哪里、故障时怎么修，这决定了团队需要补哪些测试和解释。
insights.detailEn: Faster generated code still leaves an operational question: can the team explain the gain and fix the code when it breaks?
insights.titleEn: Can the team fix the faster code?

related.reason: 回看她担任 CTO 时如何在 Netflix 建立质量标准。
related.reasonEn: Compare the standards she used when she was Netflix’s CTO.

title.en: How Netflix builds a culture of excellence | Elizabeth Stone (CTO)
title.zh: Netflix如何构建卓越文化 | 伊丽莎白·斯通（CTO）
